arcades.info_text: Cinestar Breña al lado de Metro. Hasta febrero-marzo de 2024, dos empresas operaban en el primer y segundo piso, hasta que apagaron las máquinas del primer piso. A mediados de febrero de 2025, las máquinas del primer piso fueron eliminadas, y ambos pisos son operados por la misma empresa. Venden AM.PASS (las tarjetas de PIU) en el segundo piso a S/ 25. / Cinestar Breña next to Metro. Until February-March 2024, different companies operated on the first and second floor, then the cabinets on the first floor were turned off. Around mid February 2025, the first floor's cabinets were removed, and now the entire building is operated by one company. AM.PASS are sold on the second floor counter, S/ 25 (Around $6.50).
